# `duplicate-module-import`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports two import spellings in one file that resolve to the same Zig module
path.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Multiple identities for one module can duplicate global state assumptions and
make dependency structure misleading.

## When it fires

It is a project scan rule and requires normalized paths from the workspace
scanner.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const a = @import("util.zig");
const b = @import("./util.zig");
```
